Plan your next move

Show territories

Claim it. Challenge it. Lock it.

01

Head to your location

Leave transit and reach a public outdoor location inside the territory. The first team there records its name in the "Claimed by" tab of the game sheet.

02

One challenge at a time

Confirm your arrival before revealing a card. Record the reveal order and Active status in your team tab. Finish or abandon your current challenge before opening another.

03

Secure the territory

Complete the challenge and record it for your team in the "Locked by" tab of the game sheet. This overrides the initial claim, including when stealing an opponent's unlocked territory.

04

Make your decision

Each challenge has one attempt: succeed or fail. Finish or abandon it before opening another. Failed or abandoned challenges cannot be retried. Locked territories cannot be stolen.

Honor system: the game sheet is the shared record. Device memory is optional and does not enforce team rules.
